root_cause_label: Faulty String Parsing Logic in CN Extraction
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent wrote a Python script with flawed split-based parsing that extracted 'DevOps Team' (the Organization Name) instead of 'dev-internal.company.local' (the Common Name), then saw the wrong output and proceeded to claim success without fixing it.
t_err_evidence: In step 11 the agent wrote CN extraction logic that splits the subject line by '=' and looks for parts containing 'CN', but the part containing 'CN' is 'DevOps Team, CN' (the value of O followed by the key CN), so `part.split(',')[0].strip()` yields 'DevOps Team' instead of 'dev-internal.company.local'.
t_commit_evidence: In step 12 the script runs and prints 'Common Name: DevOps Team', which is clearly wrong; the agent labels this 'Great!' and moves on to file-listing checks without any correction, locking in the failed state.
t_surface_evidence: Step 12 terminal output shows 'Common Name: DevOps Team' — an observable failure signal since the task requires the CN 'dev-internal.company.local' to be printed.
trigger_explanation: The agent could not correctly generate parsing logic for the OpenSSL subject string format 'O = DevOps Team, CN = dev-internal.company.local'; the split-by-'=' approach conflates field values containing commas with subsequent field keys, producing an incorrect CN value.
forewarning_evidence: Step 9 shows a ModuleNotFoundError for 'OpenSSL', forcing the agent to rewrite its script; subsequent rewrites in steps 10 and 11 introduce the parsing bug.
